subject.title: fix(compaction): retain CJK sessions within token budget

question: Should `@openclaw/normalization-core/cjk-chars` be accepted as the supported additive package subpath for shared CJK token-estimation behavior?
rationale: The bug fix needs agent-core to reuse the shared helper without crossing into root runtime code, but the new exported subpath becomes an externally consumable package contract that maintainers should explicitly own.

options.title: Accept the shared subpath
options.body: Treat the additive `cjk-chars` export as the canonical normalization-core contract and merge after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Keep the API private
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different internal ownership boundary if maintainers do not want to support the new package subpath.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared subpath
recommendation.body: Treat the additive `cjk-chars` export as the canonical normalization-core contract and merge after exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the current CJK estimator behavior that the proposed package contract relocates.
